label: Solar Dawn
description: Deep petrol blue and burnt amber on warm cream. The blue is the panel and the sky, the amber is the sun — a calm, trustworthy palette for solar, energy and electrical trades that avoids the eco-cliché of bright green.
notes: The warm cream background is the point: solar sites default to white-and-blue and end up looking like a utility bill. Cream plus white cards gives depth without a second brand colour. ACCENT WAS THE HARD PART — a true sun-amber (#F5930A) measures 2.32:1 on white, and accent is what the renderer paints 12px meta text with in ~15 places, so it had to be darkened along its own hue to #A26107 before it cleared AA on BOTH the cream background and the white cards. Everything measured: text 15.58/16.52, muted 5.57/5.90, accent 4.66/4.94, primary 8.97/9.51, secondary 6.25/6.62. All three brand colours are dark enough that SiteRenderer::readableOn() picks white for button text, which keeps buttons consistent.
